subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The past was not frozen.”?
options: What once came from soil can help soil again.
It taught her math, manners, memory, and patience all at once.
They are answers to problems people once faced.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「What once came from soil can help soil again.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It taught her math, manners, memory, and patience all at once.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The past was not frozen. It had once been moving.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「They are answers to problems people once faced.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The past was not frozen. It had once been moving.」，答案為「It had once been moving.」。
